name: ComfyUI-Tenstorrent
description: ComfyUI custom nodes for running Stable Diffusion XL, SD3.5, Wan 2.2, LTX-2.3 and MiniMax-H3 on Tenstorrent hardware. The nodes start and supervise a tt-metal FastAPI inference server that ships in the package, so CLIP, the UNet or DiT and the VAE all run on the device while ComfyUI keeps its own environment.
author: Sam Tisi
